constraints: Severity never weakens structural validation: every affected binding still needs an explicit transition
description: Surface intent decay and let intent declare how strongly it binds, so context does not cause blanket rejection or silent staleness
rationale: Telos found stale constraints actively mislead agents and that agents given constraints over-rejected benign changes (50-67 percent false rejections in its baseline run). Decay must be visible and obligation strength explicit.
requirements: status and doctor report intents that govern no code, bindings pinned to superseded intent revisions, unresolved bindings, and failed verification
Intent severity (must, should, prefer) is optional, defaults to must when absent, and is shown wherever an agent decides how to treat an intent
capture lists the current text, severity, and verification of each intent whose binding it requires an explicit declaration for
title: Intent freshness and severity signals
